C1290.title: PBOC Disclosed at Least 25 Payment Penalties in H1 2021, Fines Approaching 100 Million Yuan
C1290.summary: In the first half of 2021, the People's Bank of China disclosed at least 25 payment-related administrative penalties totaling 93.02 million yuan. Fourteen institutions were cited for anti-money laundering failures, three for breaching reserve fund rules, and two for violating clearing management regulations.
